title: Late findings on a completed item: note and gate without a claim or reopen
outcome: An agent that learns something after done records it on the completed item as attributed post-completion evidence; nobody reopens or reseals an item to add a note
acceptance: Parity coverage for CLI and MCP; the reopen path is unchanged and never suggested for a note

The refusal an unheld mutation on a completed item used to return no longer occurs for note and gate; other holder words keep their current refusal with a remedy that names note as the late-finding path
gate on a completed item behaves the same way as note (one bounded observation, no barrier)

note on a completed item by any project-bound session succeeds without a claim, is attributed, carries a post-completion marker, appears in show and in next changes, and never enters the existing CompletionSeal

completion.summary: Delivered completed-item late findings through note and gate without claim/reopen, with frozen-seal isolation, parity coverage, integrity backstops, and aligned docs/review instructions.
